releases.name: PunchPaw v0.1.0 (test build)
releases.body:
PunchPaw 0.1.0 (test build). A free, open source punch compressor for drums and bass (VST3).

One zip: installers for Windows (.exe), macOS (.pkg with an Uninstall app) and Linux (Flatpak extension plus a plain .vst3), the PDF manual with an interface tour, INSTALL.txt and SHA256SUMS. Everything works offline; the plugin collects nothing.

The installers are not code-signed or notarised. Windows may say "unknown publisher" (More info, Run anyway); macOS may need Privacy and Security, Open Anyway. This is not a sign of harm: the code is open and the zip has SHA256SUMS to check it.

This is a test build: automated tests and pluginval pass in CI, but it has not been checked by ear in real hosts or installed on real Windows and macOS machines yet. See ROADMAP.md.

releases.name: Apurrr2500 v0.1.2 (test build)
releases.body:
Apurrr2500 test build (pre-release). A free, open source stereo bus compressor in the style of a classic hardware unit. By Studio 87.

One zip, everything works offline:
- Windows installer (.exe) with uninstaller
- macOS installer (.pkg) with an "Uninstall Apurrr2500" app
- Linux: Flatpak extension for Flatpak DAWs, and a plain .vst3 tarball
- PDF manual with an interface tour, INSTALL.txt, LICENSE and SHA256SUMS

About the "unknown publisher" warnings: the installers are not signed (signing needs a paid certificate; this is a free project). Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": click More info, then Run anyway. macOS may block the package: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and choose Open Anyway. The checksums are in SHA256SUMS and the source is in this repository.

What is verified: the compressor core is tested in plain C++ (ranges, level calibration, response time, stability on silence, DC, full scale and NaN, aliasing, CPU, sample rates) and matches the approved mockup's engine. The plugin loads in pluginval on Linux.

What is not verified: the installers have not been run on real Windows or macOS machines yet, the plugin has not been tried in real hosts on every system, and the calibration (0 dBu = -22 dBFS, 0 VU = -18 dBFS) comes from the design mockup and has not been checked against a real hardware unit. See ROADMAP.md.

Free to use. Collects nothing. Optional support: https://ko-fi.com/studio87

New in 0.1.2: the VST3 carries its own icon on macOS and Windows.

releases.name: Pawltec v0.1.1 (test build)
releases.body:
**Test build (pre-release), 0.1.1: adds a 0 dBFS safety limiter (host parameter, on by default, untouched below 0 dBFS) and cuts tube aliasing from -53.6 to -72.5 dB. Latency is now 72 samples.**

**Test build (pre-release).** Pawltec is a free, open source tube-style program equalizer (VST3) by Studio 87: low boost and atten on a shared frequency, high boost with width, high atten, a tube stage and an Output level. It collects nothing and never uses the network.

This zip holds the installers for Windows (.exe) and macOS (.pkg), Linux Flatpak extension and plain .vst3 tarball, the PDF manual, INSTALL.txt, LICENSE and SHA256SUMS. Everything works offline.

**What is checked:** the DSP core has automatic tests (flat response, exact gains, constant latency, aliasing, level match, NaN safety), the plugin builds on Windows, macOS and Linux and passes the pluginval validator on Linux, and the window is rendered by the real compiled editor for the manual.

**What is not checked yet:** the installers on real Windows and macOS machines, the Flatpak extension in a real Flatpak DAW, the plugin in real DAWs, and the sound by ear on real material. The filter shapes are our own model, not measured from hardware.

**Why Windows or macOS may warn you:** the installers are not signed with a paid publisher certificate (it costs money every year and this project is free), so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warn about any unsigned installer. On Windows choose "More info", then "Run anyway". On macOS open System Settings, Privacy and Security, and choose "Open Anyway". You can compare the files with SHA256SUMS in the zip, and the source is on GitHub.

releases.name: CatRack v0.1.3 (test build)
releases.body:
**Test build (pre-release).** CatRack is a free, open source rack plugin (VST3) by Studio 87: up to 12 effect units in one window, in any order, with parallel pairs, bypass, solo and mute per unit, in and out meters in dB, and factory plus your own chain presets. It collects nothing and never uses the network.

This zip holds the installers for Windows (.exe) and macOS (.pkg), the Linux Flatpak extension and a plain .vst3 tarball, the PDF manual, INSTALL.txt, LICENSE and SHA256SUMS. Everything works offline.

**0.1.3:** Purr Drive, Purr Trans and Purr Fuzz now run at 4x oversampling with zero latency; aliasing at full drive is down from -33 to -43 dB to -64 to -83 dB.

**What is in this version:** 28 of the 31 units shown in the design are built in (Cat Spacer, Stretch Cat and Copycat are standalone plugins, not rack units). 23 factory chains. New since 0.1.0: Meowximizer, Cat Crusher, Fat Cat, Meowbass, Shimmer Reverb, Shimmer Delay, Hairball and Scratch Cat FX, units with more than nine controls get a page switch, a new instance opens with the Start Here chain. The units run as built-in code; CatRack never loads other plugin files.

**What is checked:** the DSP core has automatic tests (latency equals the sum of the rows, stability on every unit, state round trip), the plugin builds on Windows, macOS and Linux, passes the pluginval validator on Linux, and the window pictures are rendered by the real compiled editor.

**What is not checked yet:** the installers on real Windows and macOS machines, the Flatpak extension in a real Flatpak DAW, the plugin in real DAWs, and the sound by ear on real material. Some unit mappings are our own approximations; see ROADMAP.md.

**Why Windows or macOS may warn you:** the installers are not signed with a paid publisher certificate (it costs money every year and this project is free), so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warn about any unsigned installer. Stretch Cat 0.3.0, a test build. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Collects nothing, never connects to the network.

What is new
- NEW plugin: Stretch Cat Track Effect (an effect, installed together with the sampler). It listens to your track, HOLD freezes the last moments and repeats them as grains at any speed and pitch. Window from the approved design, HOLD and all controls automatable, dB meter, latency 0, dry sound passes bit exactly while HOLD is off. Limits: no preset browser of its own, Use regions cuts 8 equal pieces, HOLD applies at the start of an audio block.

- A real formant shift (spectral envelope warp). Limits are written in the manual.

releases.body:
**New in 0.3.30:** Voices and Detune now work on sampled instruments (detune a piano, stack a choir), 69 more sampled sets built in (pianos, bells, basses, pizzicatos, strings, choirs, supersaw recordings), sets renamed (Meow1 ..., 800 Piano), quiet presets levelled, 31 new mixed presets, banks A to U. The download is large (about 0.4 to 1.8 GB per system) because every sound is inside the plugin.

**New in 0.3.3:** sampled instruments are bundled in the plugin (pianos, strings, brass, voices and more), "Aah stab" and "AHH wave" are in the Voices group of the wave list, and there are two new drum kits. Several presets have new names.

Free and open source supersaw, hoover and acid synth by Studio 87. VST3 and standalone.

**Download the zip for your system (Windows, macOS or Linux), unzip it, and open `INSTALL.txt`.** Each zip has a real installer plus the manual (PDF) and checksums. All the sounds are inside the plugin, nothing else to download. Run the installer for your system, nothing to copy by hand. Windows has an uninstaller in Settings > Apps, macOS has an Uninstall app.

**New in 0.3.2:** drag to modulate: drag a source from the Mod tray onto a knob to set up the modulation. **New in 0.3.1:** on-screen pitch and mod wheels with separate up and down bend ranges. **New in 0.3.0:** pitch wheel with a bend range, MPE (bend, slide and press a single note of a chord), and Pressure, Slide and Bend as mod matrix sources. The plugin also reads polyphonic key pressure.

The installers are not signed yet, so the first run may show a warning. `INSTALL.txt` says which button to click.

Overwrote a factory bank? The factory banks A to D are in the repo under `presets/factory/` as `.syx` files. Import one on the Presets page (Banks, Import .syx), or press **Restore factory** there.

Found a problem? Open an issue and, if you can, use **Files > Copy diagnostics** inside the plugin and paste the result.

releases.name: MX400 Controller v0.1.2 (test build)
releases.body:
**MX400 Controller v0.1.2 (test build, early)**

Changes in v0.1.2: new blue icon; fixed the Windows installer, which could install an empty plugin folder (the plugin did not show up in the DAW). v0.1.1 and v0.1.0 are not usable on Windows.

A free, open source MIDI controller plugin for the Lexicon MX400 hardware unit. It sends CC and program change; it does not process audio. It collects nothing and works offline.

One zip: installers for Windows (.exe), macOS (.pkg), Linux (Flatpak extension and a plain .vst3), the PDF manual, INSTALL.txt and SHA-256 sums.

**Read this first**
- Not tested on a real MX400 yet. All CC numbers come from the printed manual ("official only").
- Effect type and routing values are raw 0 to 127 (the manual does not print the lists).
- Nothing is sent when a project opens. Use SEND ALL.
- Not built yet: surround trims, ducker, direct I/O, SysEx store and restore (the MX-Edit SysEx format is undocumented). SysEx can be captured and checked only.
- Installers are unsigned and not yet tested on real machines.
- New since v0.1.0: program bypass (CC 120), install notes and macOS install guide, System menu notes in the manual.

releases.name: Studio 87 Gear Updater v0.1.1 (test build)
releases.body:
Studio 87 Gear Updater 0.1.1 (test build). A free, open source window that lists every Studio 87 plugin and app, shows which have a newer version on GitHub, and updates them one by one, several at once or all together.

One zip: the Linux Flatpak, the Windows installer (.exe), the macOS installer (.pkg) if the macOS build was available, the PDF manual with an interface tour, INSTALL.txt and SHA256SUMS. A separate SHA256SUMS asset lists the zip itself. The updater checks GitHub only when you open it or click Check for updates, collects nothing, verifies SHA256 before installing, and never touches your presets.

The installers are not code-signed or notarised. Windows may say "unknown publisher" (More info, Run anyway); macOS may need Privacy and Security, Open Anyway. This is not a sign of harm: the code is open and the checksums are in the zip.

This is a test build: the automated tests, the deliberate-bug check and an offscreen render of the real window pass in CI, but it has not yet been used to install a plugin on a real machine, and the Flatpak, Windows and macOS installers have not been tried on real systems. See ROADMAP.md.


New in 0.1.1: a bigger portrait window ported from the approved mockup (resizable, fits your screen), the full public Studio 87 catalog from one small file that GitHub rebuilds every 3 hours, Install and Update buttons that say what they do, optional Sign in with GitHub (keychain, no permissions), install modes All users or Just for me, better installed-version detection. The zip is now called Studio87-Gear-Updater-v0.1.1.zip (v0.1.0 used Studio87-Updater-v0.1.0.zip); its layout is the same, so v0.1.0 can update to it.
Not tested by the author on real Windows, macOS or Linux installs yet; the OAuth token refresh is unverified.
